Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model
The unified, Turboism-owned object view of a Cubism model.

Use CubismModelAccess.active() to obtain the active model, then navigate its parameter, part, ArtMesh/drawable, deformer, and glue collections. This is one object graph: collection lookups and objects returned from a collection describe the same active model generation.

Model objects and their collection views are live, generation-bound references. A document switch, reload, close, object deletion, provider replacement, or plugin disable can make a reference stale. Callers must reacquire objects from the active model rather than retaining a reference or using an old ID to guess a replacement. Implementations fail closed when they can detect such a stale reference.

Simple records such as ArtMeshGeometry, WarpGrid, and RotationDeformerForm are detached immutable value snapshots. Their list inputs are copied and their list accessors are unmodifiable. Collection and sequence results expose values through immutable lists or indexed views; they never grant ownership of backend arrays.

A read may describe an evaluated/Core-backed result. For a model attached to an Editor document, writes that a provider supports target Editor authoring state, which is the sole source of truth; evaluation state is not an alternate authoring plane. API presence does not make a feature provider-ready for every Cubism version. Unsupported or unverifiable operations fail explicitly and this package never exposes host implementation objects.
